title: MERN Commerce
description: Full-stack store with JWT auth, cart, Stripe checkout, an admin dashboard and image uploads. REST API built with Express and Mongoose.

title: Realtime Chat
description: Chat app with rooms, typing indicators and online presence using Socket.io, with message history kept in MongoDB.

title: Kanban Board
description: Drag-and-drop task board with custom hooks, context + reducer state and localStorage persistence.

title: Movie Finder
description: React SPA with routing, debounced search, infinite scroll and skeleton loading on top of a public movie API.

title: Weather Now
description: Vanilla JavaScript weather app using async/await, the Geolocation API and dynamic DOM rendering. No frameworks.

title: Responsive Landing Page
description: Pixel-careful landing page in semantic HTML and modern CSS: Grid, Flexbox, fluid type with clamp() and an accessible nav.
